text:
People keep saying Opus got nerfed. Meanwhile, it made this for $5.03 🐋

Decided to test it with a jelly sperm whale. You remember I called Opus the jelly king, so my expectations were high

And honestly, it did just as well as before. Just look at how this whale stretches and rolls around

Can’t speak for other tasks, but when it comes to jelly, this still looks like the same old Opus to me
